question: What happens to one who produces fruit-stained action?
premises: Producing fruit-stained action becomes fit for fruit attainment.
Whoever even there with firmness abandons fruit impression.
Thus firm abandonment changes the result.
inference: One who produces fruit-stained action becomes fit for fruit attainment, but firm abandonment of fruit impression alters it.
plain_english: Producing fruit-stained action becomes fit for fruit attainment; whoever even there with firmness abandons fruit impression.
